summary: Forwarding thunk: calls the __thiscall helper ShortArrayZeroInit(this) and returns the same this pointer. The function is a thin wrapper whose only purpose is to zero-initialize the object's short array and hand the object back, so it can be used as a constructor-like call in object/pool setup paths.

operations.description: Invoke __thiscall callee ShortArrayZeroInit (0x00491330) on the this pointer to zero-initialize its short array.
Used as an initialization step by CustomMemoryPoolAllocatorInit (0x004906E0), ResourcePoolNodeAllocDealloc (0x00490940), sub_490B00 (0x00490B00) and ConstructorWith1Sentinels (0x0049A930).

unresolved: Element type and count of the short array zeroed by the callee are not visible in this thunk.
